faq.q: What is the source and how often is it updated?
faq.a: USGS, NHC and NWS feeds retrieved daily at 18:00 JST (observation started 2026-08-30). Last updated 2026-09-19 18:35 JST. Machine-readable: https://ai-lifeline.org/us/api/disaster_us.json

faq.q: What can this data not tell you?
faq.a: What this chapter cannot say (ledger v1.0, approved 2026-09-05; full text in the method section): What damage, casualties or facility impacts any event caused (counts only); Whether a hurricane, earthquake or heat wave will occur (no forecasts); Wildfire activity (a candidate until the NIFC licence is verified), or how U.S. hazard levels compare with Japan or the EU (different scales and profiles).
